entities.summary: Angelo Massafra is an Italian Catholic archbishop of Arbëreshë ancestry, metropolitan archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Shkodër–Pult since 25 January 2005. Monsignor Massafra from 2025 resign as Archbishop of Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Shkodër-Pult Giovanni Peragine.
